news.title: New minor risk - Shareholder dilution
news.body: The company's shareholders have been diluted in the past year. Increase in shares outstanding: 17% This is considered a minor risk. Shareholder dilution occurs when there is an increase in the number of shares on issue that is not proportionally distributed between all shareholders. Often due to the company raising equity capital or some options being converted into stock. All else being equal, if there are more shares outstanding then each existing share will be entitled to a lower proportion of the company's total earnings, thus reducing earnings per share (EPS). While dilution might not always result in lower EPS (like if the company is using the capital to fund an EPS accretive acquisition) in a lot cases it does, along with lower dividends per share and less voting power at shareholde

news.title: Rose Merc Limited (BSE:512115) executed a non-binding Letter of Intent to acquire 30% stake in Virtual Gain Technologies Private Limited for for approximately INR 150 million.
news.body:
Rose Merc Limited (BSE:512115) executed a non-binding Letter of Intent to acquire 30% stake in Virtual Gain Technologies Private Limited for approximately INR 150 million on December 8, 2025. A cash consideration of INR 150 million will be paid by Rose Merc Limited. As part of consideration, INR 150 million is paid towards common equity of Virtual Gain Technologies Private Limited.

For the period ending March 31, 2025, Virtual Gain Technologies Private Limited reported total revenue of INR 9.89 million.
